title: 第483章 墙倒众人推
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林奇负手立于青纹岩蜥的头颅之上，居高临下的俯视摩罗斯。

“看来，你十分了解我这坐骑。”

即使戴着面具，依旧能感受的出来对方神态倨傲，不可一世。

众人心里对林奇的身份更是拿捏不准。

林奇很满意对方的反应。

他这样张狂的姿态，为的就是要分散对方的注意力，好给杰克寻找机会潜入过来。

“嘶嘶。”

青纹岩蜥仿佛嗅到了摩罗斯的气息，尾巴开始摇摆起来，眼神中带着一丝异样。

“果然是同一只……”

摩罗斯面色一沉。

当青纹岩蜥出现那一刻，他对林奇原本的不屑变成了忌惮。

如果来的只是一个八星御卡大师，那他绝对能让对方有来无回。

即便，林奇有着一只领主级的卡兽。

可偏偏，对方的这只领主级卡兽是青纹岩蜥，那性质就不一样了。

一年前，

摩罗斯带人在灰烬之森猎杀卡兽时，遇到过青纹岩蜥。

他损失了五十多个手下才带人逃脱，对这卡兽的难缠程度印象十分深刻。

摩罗斯是个极度自信疯狂的人，

他自认要是全力以赴，也能战胜青纹岩蜥。

可是要将这卡兽封印成御兽卡，那可就难如登天了。

一念至此，

摩罗斯心底的疑惑与忌惮愈发浓烈，死死盯着被黑袍遮掩的林奇。

“你究竟是什么人？”

他十分疑惑，到底是谁盯上了他苦心经营数年的火护军团。

林奇冷笑一声：“要你狗命的人！”

话音落下，裂空螳螂果断出手。

“唰！”

一道幽镰斩划破空气，直取摩罗斯首级？

这一击快如闪电，让人猝不及防。

“铛！”

千钧一发之际，

一柄漆黑的长剑横立在摩罗斯面前，挡住了这一击。

“有点东西。”

林奇眼神微眯，目光紧锁那柄黑剑，眼底闪过一丝讶异。

那柄剑模样奇特，不像骑士长剑那般厚重，也不像游侠的长剑那般轻盈。

漆黑的剑身中间，一条妖异的血色纹路贯穿其中。

尤其是剑柄处还有一个狰狞的骷髅头，萦绕着阵阵黑气，看上去诡异无比。

“上！”

摩罗斯一声令下，示意手下动手。

可周遭山贼面面相觑，却无一人敢上前半步。

无论是面前这黑袍人，还是那领主级青纹岩蜥，都让众人感到胆寒。

Page (1/3)

Lin Qi stood on the head of the blue-striped rock lizard with his hands behind his back, looking down at Moros from a high position.

"It seems that you know my mount very well."

Even with the mask on, you can still feel the other person's arrogance and arrogance.

Everyone was even more unsure about Lin Qi's identity.

Lynch was pleased with the reaction.

The purpose of his arrogant posture was to distract the opponent so that Jack could find an opportunity to sneak in.

"Hiss."

The blue-striped rock lizard seemed to smell the breath of Moros, and its tail began to wag, with a strange look in its eyes.

"It's indeed the same one..."

Moros's face darkened.

The moment the blue-striped rock lizard appeared, his original disdain for Lin Qi turned into fear.

If only an eight-star card master comes, then he will definitely make the opponent unable to come back.

Even though Lynch has a lord-level card beast.

However, the opponent's lord-level card beast is a blue-patterned rock lizard, so its nature is different.

a year ago,

When Moros led his people to hunt Ka beasts in the Forest of Ashes, they encountered a blue-striped rock lizard.

He lost more than fifty of his men before leading his men to escape, and was very impressed by how difficult this beast was.

Moros is an extremely confident and crazy person.

He believed that if he tried his best, he could defeat the Blue Striped Rock Lizard.

But to seal this card beast into a beast-controlling card would be as difficult as ascending to the sky.

One thought comes to this,

The doubts and fears in Moros's heart became more and more intense, and he stared at Lin Qi, who was covered by the black robe.

"Who are you exactly?"

He was very confused as to who was eyeing the Fire Guard Legion that he had worked so hard for several years.

Lin Qi sneered: "The person who wants your life!"

After the words fell, Skycracking Mantis took decisive action.

"Uh-huh!"

A ghost sickle cut through the air and took Moros's head?

The strike was as fast as lightning, catching people off guard.

"Cang!"

At the critical moment,

A long black sword stood in front of Moros, blocking the blow.

"Something."

Lin Qi narrowed his eyes slightly and locked his gaze on the black sword, with a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.

The sword looked strange, not as heavy as the knight's sword, nor as light as the ranger's sword.

In the middle of the pitch-black sword body, a strange bloody line runs through it.

In particular, there is a ferocious skull on the hilt of the sword, surrounded by bursts of black energy, which looks extremely weird.

"Up!"

Moros gave an order and motioned for his men to take action.

But the bandits around him looked at each other, but no one dared to take a step forward.

Whether it was the black-robed man in front of them or the lord-level blue-patterned rock lizard, everyone felt terrified.
